sources.name: SEC Form 4 insider transactions
sources.notes: Open-market insider purchases can become mirror candidates after provenance, price-drift, and risk checks. Grants, gifts, exercises, and tax-withholding transactions stay research-only.

sources.name: SEC Form 13F manager holdings
sources.notes: Quarter-end holdings can be filed up to 45 days later and do not reveal an exact trade time, so they are context rather than copy orders.

sources.name: Congressional periodic transaction reports
sources.notes: Public transaction reports can arrive up to 45 days after a trade and often show value ranges, so they are research-only.

sources.name: Verified public trader signal
sources.notes: Disabled until the operator names a person and a stable, attributable public source. Screenshots, anonymous posts, and edited messages are not sufficient provenance.
